text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Deploy to eu-west-1 completed (green). Observed spike in TLS handshake failures for eu-ingress-service. Rolling metrics attached: 5xx_tls_handshake up 18% in last 2m.

mike_sre: seeing client errors too — curl to eu.api returns TLS alert handshake failure.

anya_prodeng: confirmed. Repro locally: `curl -v https://eu.api.redwood.ai/health` -> `SSL: certificate subject name 'blue.internal' does not match 'eu.api.redwood.ai'`

eva_release: that sounds like the green deployment picked up the old cert bundle (CN mismatch). Did cert reload run as part of the rollout? I triggered cert rotation earlier.

leo_network: looking at LB SNI mapping — green backends are returning a cert with subject blue.internal for some nodes (subset ~22%). Possibly config propagation lag in the SSL proxy.

sarah_support: Customer impact: alerts from 3 enterprise tenants in EU. ~6% of API requests failing with TLS errors, mostly short-lived retries. No data loss but app errors surfaced to end users. Slack threads from customers are coming in.

oncall-pager: Paging the oncall SRE. @mike_sre take it? :white_check_mark:

mike_sre: taking. Switching to incident channel and starting mitigation steps. Priority: reduce customer impact -> fail traffic off green -> rollback or kill-switch.

mike_sre: quick check: `kubectl get pods -l app=eu-ingress -o wide` shows pods in green pool with certmount version v1.2.0 and blue are v1.3.1. That explains CN mismatch.

eva_release: I did a config job that rotated cert->v1.3.1 but it looks like the green job used an older image (image tag mismatch). Possibly the deployment controller pulled an older pod template.

anya_prodeng: mitigation plan: 1) flip traffic weights back to blue (immediate), 2) scale down green pool, 3) investigate image tag resolution. Can flip weights via console or runbook.

mike_sre: initiating weight flip now. Command: `curl -X POST https://internal-api/rollouts/weights -d '{"region":"eu","blue":100,"green":0}'` (internal only). Executed.

deploy-bot: Traffic weights updated: eu: blue=100 green=0. Health checks stable. :white_check_mark:

leo_network: LB logs show handshake failures dropped to baseline within 30s of weight flip.

sarah_support: Notifying impacted customers: sent status update noting rollback and mitigation, ETA for root cause analysis 2h.

anya_prodeng: creating incident ticket and assigning to release team to prevent reoccurrence. Runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/tls-swap

mike_sre: oncall handing off to @anya_prodeng for follow-up RCA. I’ll stay available for escalation. :handshake:

oncall-pager: Acknowledged handoff. Incident severity set to SEV2. Timeline and notes added to ticket.

eva_release: immediate action item: lock image tag resolution in deploy pipeline, add pre-rollout cert-check that verifies CN matches target host.

sarah_support: Logged customer impact summary: 3 tenants affected, 6% error rate peak, no data corruption. Email update scheduled in 45m.

mike_sre: closing mitigation loop in channel. Marking this thread as mitigation complete. Will attach logs and pod diff in the incident ticket.

deploy-bot: Incident auto-summary: partial TLS handshake failures during eu green rollout caused by stale cert image on subset of green pods. Mitigated by traffic weight rollback. Follow-up: pipeline fixes, cert prechecks.
